text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah! A ship!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: HEEEEY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Did you see that!? She waved back at 
me!
choice_data_list:
Our voices really do reach them, after 
all...

Our voices really do reach them, don't 
they...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm feeling good! —Let's start 
the Derby review, shall we?
choice_data_list: 声、届くんだもんなぁ……
声、届くんだもんねぇ……
choice_data_list_en: Our voices really do reach them, huh...
Our voices really do reach them, don't they...

text_block_list.text:
Leading Epiphaneia to victory at the 
Kikuka Sho in such flawless fashion that 
everyone would feel it was destiny—

For that sake, first we need to look back 
on the Japan Derby that didn't go well.

Even at the Satsuki Sho, she ran with 
tremendous momentum... Yet, she herself 
was still fully aware of it.

"However, at the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)... the voice of destiny ran wild 
and spun completely out of control."
choice_data_list: I wonder what was different?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Something that was different? Hmmm...
choice_data_list: 何が違ったんだろう？

text_block_list.text:
"Her own will comes before the voice of 
destiny. I already know their relationship 
is one where the voice merely affirms her 
will. If there's any change—"
choice_data_list: For example, your mindset towards races.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In that case, that burning desire to win 
was so intensely passionate!!
choice_data_list: たとえば、レースへの心持ちとか
choice_data_list_en: Like your mindset going into a race, for example.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Way more than during the Satsuki Sho! 
—Because I was thinking about everyone 
too!
choice_data_list: You mean everyone?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone who cheers me on, Cesario, 
Kris S... and Trainer.
choice_data_list: みんなのこと？

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to watch me! I want to win 
for everyone's sake!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking that made my chest seethe with 
heat... and I heard the voice of destiny 
screaming, 'Win!'"

Heading into the Derby, Epiphaneia's 
fighting spirit was burning higher than 
ever before.

And yet... because you tried to forcefully 
suppress it, it triggered a massive 
backlash explosion instead.
choice_data_list: And the voice of fate affirmed it...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I shouldn't think about 
wanting to win anymore?
choice_data_list: そして運命の声がそれを肯定した……
choice_data_list_en: And the voice of destiny affirmed it...

text_block_list.text:
A straightforward desire to win is only 
natural. Therefore, your overflowing 
fighting spirit is not the problem.
choice_data_list: いや、それは違う
ううん、それは違う

text_block_list.text:
What we should consider is how to control 
it. Trying to suppress it only ended up 
making the runaways worse. In that case—
choice_data_list: Alright, let's check out the race footage.

text_block_list.name: Epi during the Race
text_block_list.text: “OOOooohhhhhh h o oOOooOh!!!!”
choice_data_list: よし、次はレース映像を見てみよう
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's watch the race footage next.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I'm scary right now! So this is what 
it means to be way too aggressive!
choice_data_list: (...Still, I can't take my eyes off her.)

text_block_list.text:
When she's running wild—she possesses an 
immense driving force. If she could 
maintain that momentum without losing 
control, and run like that from start to 
finish—
choice_data_list: （……でも、目を奪われる）
choice_data_list_en: (...Still, I can't take my eyes off her.)

text_block_list.text:
I play the race footage back frame by 
frame. When Epiphaneia ran wild, running 
on raw emotion alone, her form had 
completely fallen apart.
choice_data_list: （……いや、今はもっと手前の話だ）
（……ううん、今はもっと手前の話）
choice_data_list_en: (...No, that's getting ahead of where we are right now.)

text_block_list.text:
First, she needs to start by understanding 
the correlation between fighting spirit 
and running style. As for the specific 
method—
choice_data_list: Guess I'll look into a few things...

text_block_list.text:
And so, I expanded my research to basic 
training books, scientific papers, and 
even psychology—
choice_data_list: 色々と調べてみるか……
choice_data_list_en: Guess I'll look into a few things...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!!!!!! Well, what do you 
think!?!?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: (Staaaare...)
choice_data_list: L-let's go outside.

text_block_list.text:
Following Epiphaneia's intuition, I came 
up to the rooftop. Right now, she's 
reading a sports science magazine 
featuring articles on race events.
choice_data_list: そ、外に行こう

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh! Is that baseball?! Lemme watch!
choice_data_list: Do you like it?
Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's fun, so I love it!
choice_data_list: 好きなのか？
好きなの？

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hitting a ton of home runs feels super 
refreshing and invigorating, after all!
choice_data_list: (Hmm, just as expected...)
(Hmm, impressive...)

text_block_list.text:
While chatting and looking over the 
baseball page... an intriguing column 
caught my eye.
choice_data_list: （うーん、さすがだ……）
（うーん、さすが……）

text_block_list.text:
The column published analysis data on 
baseball players' movements based on 
sports biomechanics.
choice_data_list: スポーツバイオメカニクスか……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's a huge deal in pro baseball and 
stuff, right! Using cameras and sensors to 
turn body movements into data!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"By adopting an objective perspective, the 
team's players saw improved 
performance"... Huh, guess that's pretty 
important!
choice_data_list: (I see... Objective data analysis!)

text_block_list.text:
Objectively understanding her own body's 
movements is what Epiphaneia needs right 
now. If you could give her advice from 
that perspective...!
choice_data_list: （そうか……客観的なデータ解析！）

text_block_list.text:
—I contacted the teacher by email first. I 
outlined the current situation and added 
that I wanted to meet and talk in person.
choice_data_list: （このコラムの先生に連絡してみよう！）
choice_data_list_en: (I'll try contacting the expert from this column!)

text_block_list.text:
However, unfortunately, the reply we 
received was a polite refusal...
choice_data_list: （いいお返事をもらえますように……）

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Too bad!! Why did they say no?
choice_data_list: Umm...

text_block_list.text:
I re-read the contents. The gist of it is: 
"My expertise lies in human athletes, and 
having never worked with an Umamusume, I 
cannot provide proper coaching."
choice_data_list: ええと……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So you mean they don't want to meddle in 
things outside their expertise without 
care. Must be a really serious person!
choice_data_list: (But if that's the only reason...)

text_block_list.text:
Asking again for something that was once 
refused might be terribly rude. However—
choice_data_list: （でも、もしそれだけが理由なら……）

text_block_list.text:
Teacher's guidance will help improve my 
running. If there's even a fraction of a 
percent of a chance―― I will seize it, no 
matter what!
choice_data_list: I'll try talking to them directly!
I'll try asking them directly.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was just thinking the exact same 
thing! You gotta express your feelings 
straight and true!
choice_data_list: 俺、直接相談してみるよ
私、直接相談してみるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll go consult with them directly.

text_block_list.text:
Having Epiphaneia with me might make it 
easier to push my feelings through... but 
that wouldn't be a sincere way to handle 
things.
choice_data_list: いいや、俺ひとりで行かせてくれ
ううん、私ひとりで行かせてくれる？
choice_data_list_en: No, let me go by myself.
No, could you let me go on my own?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Got it! I'm counting on you, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: 必ず気持ちを伝えてくるから、待ってて！
choice_data_list_en: I'll make sure to convey my feelings, so wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, you must be... Hello. I was surprised 
to receive your message...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I intended to include all my reasons for 
declining in my reply, but...
choice_data_list:
I apologize. But I really must speak with 
you...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. If there was anything I 
could do to help, I'd love to, but...
choice_data_list: すみません。ですが、どうしてもお話を……
choice_data_list_en: I'm sorry. But I really need to speak with you...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I looked into it after you contacted me, 
but an Umamusume's physiology is 
deceptively different from a human's... I 
hear there is still much that remains 
unexplained.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, I am not familiar with 
Umamusume racing. I doubt I could be of 
any help...
choice_data_list:
Regarding that, I've prepared some 
materials—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—'To what extent can insights from sports 
biomechanics influence an Umamusume's 
training?' ...Is that it?"
choice_data_list: それについて、資料を作ったのですが――
choice_data_list_en: I've prepared some materials regarding that—

text_block_list.text:
"Understanding the key mechanics will lead 
to improving your form. I've also compiled 
data on just how much of a positive effect 
we can expect."
choice_data_list: はい、自分なりにまとめてきました
choice_data_list_en: Yes, I put together a summary of my own.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
From the fundamentals of Umamusume 
racing... to how they connect with my past 
research presentations... You've 
investigated it all quite thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...You seem confident that my work will 
be effective for your Umamusume."
choice_data_list: ...Yes, I am certain of it.

text_block_list.text:
I recall Epiphaneia's imposing confidence. 
I won't say all our trial and error so far 
was a mistake. However... my resolve 
hadn't been strong enough.
choice_data_list: ……そうです、“確信”しています

text_block_list.text:
Having resolve—that means deciding your 
choice is "right"... and moving forward 
with unwavering conviction.
choice_data_list: I want to give her everything she needs.

text_block_list.text:
I bowed deeply in humble apology. Even if 
it might be seen as a mere formality, I 
hoped to convey even a fraction of my 
sincerity—
choice_data_list: 必要なものを、彼女に全て与えたいんです
choice_data_list_en: I want to give her everything she needs.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Please raise your head. I've understood 
how you feel.
choice_data_list: どうか、お力添えを……！

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If you go that far to say so, 
I'll look into various things as well. And 
after that... I will watch Epiphaneia's 
run.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.text:
After coordinating schedules with the 
teacher, we arranged for them to watch 
Epiphaneia run during the upcoming summer 
training camp.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます……！
